description: This file implements the TlsChloExtractor class, which processes QUIC handshake packets, extracts TLS ClientHello information, manages SSL/TLS state, and handles errors related to QUIC and TLS handshake parsing.

classes.name: TlsChloExtractor
classes.description: Handles extraction and processing of TLS ClientHello messages within QUIC handshake packets, manages SSL/TLS state, and error handling.

methods.name: IngestPacket
methods.description: Processes incoming QUIC packets, initializes parser if needed, and updates internal state based on parsed frames.

methods.name: OnUnauthenticatedPublicHeader
methods.description: Handles the unencrypted header of a QUIC packet, sets up decryption if necessary.

methods.name: OnProtocolVersionMismatch
methods.description: Handles version mismatch during parsing, should not be called under normal circumstances.

methods.name: OnUnrecoverableError
methods.description: Records unrecoverable errors encountered during processing.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Handles CRYPTO frames during parsing, updates internal state.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Provides accumulated crypto data to BoringSSL for handshake processing.

methods.name: GetInstanceFromSSL
methods.description: Retrieves the TlsChloExtractor instance associated with a given SSL object.

methods.name: SetReadSecretCallback
methods.description: Callback for setting read secrets during TLS handshake.

methods.name: SetWriteSecretCallback
methods.description: Callback for setting write secrets during TLS handshake.

methods.name: FlushFlightCallback
methods.description: Callback for flushing TLS flight data.

methods.name: SendAlert
methods.description: Sends TLS alert messages, handles handshake failure scenarios.

methods.name: SelectCertCallback
methods.description: Selects TLS certificate based on ClientHello, cancels further processing.

methods.name: HandleParsedChlo
methods.description: Extracts server name, ALPN, and other info from ClientHello, updates internal state.

methods.name: GetSharedSslHandles
methods.description: Creates and returns shared SSL context and associated data index.

methods.name: SetupSslHandle
methods.description: Initializes per-instance SSL handle for BoringSSL.

methods.name: HandleUnrecoverableError
methods.description: Records unrecoverable errors and updates internal state.

methods.name: StateToString
methods.description: Converts internal state enum to string for debugging.
